newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-El Paso started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-El Paso started as buy.

text.p: -- Rauscher Pierce Refsnes initiated coverage of El Paso Energy Corp with a buy-market outperformer rating.
-- The Dallas-based investment firm set a target of $64 a share, or 16.5 times Rauscher's 1998 earnings estimate, over next 12 months.
-- It set an EPS estimate of $2.85 in 1996, $3.30 in 1997, $3.90 in 1998.
-- Rauscher Pierce Refsnes said it sees 15 percent earnings growth in 1996 excluding non-recurring charges, and 14 percent earnings growth through the end of the decade.
